#### Introduction

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The *Centre for Studies in Hindu Conservatism* (CSHC) is an intellectual initiative dedicated to publishing essays and well-researched articles on history, political philosophy, civilisational thought, strategic affairs, economics, theology, media, literature, and public discourse through the lens of Hindu Conservatism. Founded by a collective of young scholars and thinkers, CSHC seeks to contribute towards a more serious and self-aware academic culture rooted in Bharatiya civilizational consciousness.

[](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Yx_j!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe4b41b13-bb65-462f-999b-236c1ea7d18c_854x1280.png)
